definition.title: The Northern Works
definition.briefing: Bryn scouts the northern works alone while Sena holds Deep Gate. Take the pump plans at the east archive and return through the high western passage. Two detections bring down the tunnel shutters.
definition.successText: The plans identify the Warden's pressure chambers. Bryn takes the northern maintenance path into the final battle.
definition.failureText: Bryn raises a second alarm or falls in the works. Begin again outside the tunnel shutters.

objectives.text: Reach the marked archive at (29, 6) without two alarms.
Return Bryn Deepforge to (6, 29) with the archive. Move around guard sight cones; fighting is optional.
